claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.118 UX audit exposed prompt/build scaffolds in Course FAQ prose and PPTX speaker-note metadata.
Course FAQ compilation rewrites weekly-assessment, source-packet, anchor-contrast, and generic Week-artifact scaffolds before export.
PPTX exports use natural instructor/accessibility note labels instead of raw visual-guidance marker labels.
The quality defect pattern table treats raw PPTX visual-note marker labels as P0 internal scaffolds.
The release explicitly requires a fresh deployed v0.15.119 ZIP/log audit before claiming clean provider quality.
